# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_WIDTH_EXPANSION_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

An expanding EMA ribbon (EMA9-EMA50 widening) with RSI >55 signals strengthening momentum, suitable for a long on a pullback to the 20-EMA. This edge exists because a widening ribbon indicates increasing trend strength and momentum, while a pullback to the 20-EMA in such context offers a high-probability continuation entry with defined risk.

## Mechanism

Compute ribbon_width = EMA9 - EMA50 on 5-minute bars. When ribbon_width increases for two consecutive bars and RSI(14) >55, wait for price to touch or cross below the EMA20 (within 0.1% tolerance) on a bullish close (close > open); enter long at the next bar open. Exit: Stop at the low of the signal bar or 0.3% below entry; target at 1.5R or trail using 15% of highest-since-entry HWM. Regime hint: Favors trending regimes with VIX <20 and after 10:00 ET when the ribbon has had time to develop; avoid choppy periods where ribbon width oscillates without direction.
